correctness.rationale: Read final RESULT.md: diameter-two maximal geodesics are exactly the 3-vertex paths consisting of one full 2-cell column and one cell of a distinct column. Vertex-disjoint k-packings correspond bijectively to choosing k different full columns, k singleton cells from 2(n−k) remaining cells, and a bijection between the two selected sets. This gives n!/(n−k)! binom(2(n−k),k), k≤floor(2n/3); substitution at the support endpoint yields the three residue counts. The exact consecutive ratio separates into positive strictly decreasing factors on the interior, proving strict log-concavity. A geodesic-free vertex subset contains either at most one vertex per column or is exactly one full column. The complement transform yields z^n(z+2)^n+n z^(2n−2), n=2 exception 6, and inclusion-minimal transversal classification. Independent graph-distance/backtracking enumeration checked n=2..6, including the n=2 boundary.
